rationale: sbx v0.38 makes a bare `rm` prompt for confirmation and refuse outright with no TTY attached, so every non-interactive removal now needs `-f` just to complete. RemovePixSandbox's argv moved from a hand-rolled `env.Run("sbx", "rm", "-f", name)` literal to the shared sandbox.PlanForceRemove planner (same pix-* scope/name-safety check as the existing sandbox.PlanRemove), which the automatic reaper and orphan sweep also now use for the same reason. The seam itself is unchanged: RemovePixSandbox is still reachable only from a named `pix rm --force`.
